data.question: What additive, source-backed historical incoming-sharing observations can be added to request #1907 without overstating current Onondaga platform state or use?
data.method: Compared current #1907 canonical records and issue history against fresh retrievals of seven official Flock Transparency Portal pages, then preserved each donor-agency-to-Onondaga observation with the page's own displayed Last Updated date.
data.framework: Public portal sharing snapshots, native SharedNetworks configuration, approval history, reciprocity, and actual query/event activity are separate evidence levels.
data.scope: Public institutional Flock sharing metadata only; no private-person enrichment.
findings: Seven official Flock public portals list Onondaga County NY SO under Who has access?, with displayed Last Updated dates spanning 2025-10-26 through 2025-12-09.
The observations are directional donor-agency -> Onondaga County NY SO portal listings.
The displayed portal timestamps predate this September 2026 pass, so they provide historical sharing evidence rather than a current-state assertion.
conclusions: The #1907 historical sharing ledger can be extended with seven source-backed incoming-access observations while leaving current native sharing state unresolved.
No reciprocal share, approval/effective date, active September 2026 state, Onondaga account identity, or actual query should be inferred from these portal listings.
recommendations: Recover native Onondaga SharedNetworks, Network Audit, and Organization Audit exports to confirm which relationships persisted, changed, or ended after the portal timestamps.
Recover Onondaga user/admin and query/event records before asserting actual use of any donor agency's data.
counterarguments: Flock public transparency portals are vendor-published summaries and are not equivalent to tenant audit/configuration exports.
A live URL with an old displayed Last Updated date must not be treated as proof of present-day sharing.
limitations: The pages expose snapshot-style recipient lists but not historical change events, approval actors, or exact effective/end dates.
No native Onondaga platform export was available in this pass.
unresolved: Which of the seven donor relationships, if any, remained active after their 2025 portal timestamps?
Were any relationships reciprocal, and who approved them?
Did any Onondaga account actually query data from these donor networks?
